title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E5 — Inside Martha's Vegetable Greenhouse; Seed Starting
Martha takes us inside her vegetable greenhouse to see how she has turned her harvest into a year-round bounty; she collects, stores, and sows seeds, and makes her perfect green drink.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E6 — The Incredible World of Orchids
Martha visits the incredible Orchid Show at the New York Botanical Garden; this year's show immerses you in a mesmerizing array of orchids designed by acclaimed artist Lily Kwong.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E6 — Steak Night
From a pan seared steak with bordelaise sauce to a classic sizzling steak fired up on the grill, Martha makes steak dinners cooked to perfection with the help of her Head of Culinary at the farm.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E8 — Paella on an Open Fire
Martha creates the perfect menu for a paella party that will have your guests coming back for seconds; her paella is served with gazpacho and her incredible sangria.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E9 — Vietnamese Cuisine
Martha creates an incredible Vietnamese feast with her friend Monica Tran, including lettuce-wrapped golden fried spring rolls, traditional pho soup, and savory sizzling pancakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E2 — Maine Lobster Dinner
The man behind Beal's Lobster Pier, where Martha's loves to dine in Maine, shows viewers everything they need to know about boiling lobster; then, Martha turns up the flavor with her spicy lobster linguine.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E3 — Pizza Perfection: Sicilian and Neapolitan-Style Pizzas
Martha serves up delicious homemade pizzas alongside friends and pizza chefs Christian Petroni and Dean Medico; featuring classic pizzas, signature sauces, and more.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E4 — Japanese Cuisine: Sushi, Sashimi and More
Martha visits the Japanese restaurant Joji in the heart of New York, where Chef George Ruan shares his secrets for the ultimate omakase experience; culinary giant Daniel Boulud stops by.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E5 — Brunch Favorites
Martha starts off brunch with a citrus cocktail Mary's knees; Chef Ignacio Mattos joins and makes an omelette with caviar and crème fraîche; Martha makes an endive salad; Martha makes waffles.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E6 — How to Make Croissants and Sourdough Bread
Martha journeys through her local area in search of the ultimate fresh-baked croissants and sourdough bread; learning about homemade bread and pastries.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E6 — Halloween Party; Caramel Apples; Box Lantern; Cookies
Adult Halloween party; caramel apples; pumpkins.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E6 — Halloween Pumpkins; Cookies; Costumes; Decorating
Carving pumpkins; Halloween cookies; costumes; face painting; decorating holiday door; trick or treaters at Turkey Hill.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S7 E29
Red snapper en papillote; making juices; labeling buttons; veneer lampshades; dry cleaning; glazed lamb shanks.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S7 E39 — Face Painters; Halloween Cookie Decorations; Creepy Crawlers
Fig flambé; homemade lollipops; peanut-butter face painting; Halloween cookies; tarantulas and scorpions.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E4 — Mushrooms
Buckwheat crêpes filled with a mushroom mixture; vegetarian mushroom ragù served on rigatoni; French mushroom soup; mushroom risotto made with farro.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E5 — Sandwiches
Five classic sandwiches -- roasted chicken club, New Orleans po'boy with oysters, muffuletta, applewood-smoked bacon and fried egg sandwich, and a Reuben.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E7 — French Bistro Classics
Lamb navarin; Niçoise salad; a melted ham and cheese croque monsieur topped with a béchamel sauce; celery root rémoulade.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E8 — The Grind
Glazed meatloaf; hot Italian-style pork sausage; making burgers using a custom blend of meats; meatballs with ricotta.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E10 — Italian Favorites
Eight-layer pork ragù; béchamel-filled lasagna baked in ramekins; chicken Parmesan; raviolo with an egg yolk and ricotta-spinach filling; linguine with clam sauce.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E2 — Growing Citrus
Martha explores the incredible world of citrus from yuzus and kumquats to citrons and mandarins; Martha visits Flavors by Bhumi in her home state of New Jersey to learn all about growing citrus.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E2 — Coffee Shop Favorites
Apple cider doughnut cake with whole grain wheat flour and applesauce; maple-glazed pumpkin spelt scones; seeded graham biscotti.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E3 — For the Cookie Jar
Pecan, oat and dark chocolate chunk cookies; chewy molasses crinkles; slice-and-bake buckwheat espresso cookies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E4 — Alternative Crusts
Plum galette with a cornmeal crust; dairy-free chocolate coconut pie; whole-wheat olive oil-crusted mushroom tart with tahini.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E5 — Flour Power
Custardy-herb quiche with a malty rye crust; blueberry coffee cake with muesli topping; a seeded quick bread.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E7 — Yeasted Breakfast Favorites
Hazelnut hot cross buns with dried cherries; honeyed whole-wheat bread; pull-apart whole-wheat monkey bread.
